# R6.6 — site-claims-pages (manifest 259, block SITE, alias F2-f + F2-g)

Base: `origin/main` @`166a67ef` (R6.5, PR #299). Two ordered stages, checkpoint committed green before stage 2 — `73308a4a` stage 1, `147acff8` stage 2, `71a703a2` build memory. `mergePolicy: OPERATOR` — never merged by the agent.

## What landed

- **`scripts/claims-lexicon.json`** — the single banned-phrase source (`banned`, `record_banned`, `site_banned`, `conditional`). `check-position.sh` reads it **fail-closed**, byte-identical behaviour (C-25); `test-check-position.sh` adds a missing-lexicon negative mutation. (REQ-XF-134)
- **`scripts/check-site.sh`** — the fourteen §9.4 legs: lexicon, conditional, intervals, ranks, availability, provenance, labels, no-third-party, a11y-static, links, budgets, determinism, drift, hygiene. Exit 0/1/2; `--head`; `--profile internal|public`; optional caller-built `SITE_DIR`. Visible strings include text-bearing attributes + SVG titles. (REQ-XF-127/135/137/138, REQ-XD-003/092, REQ-XC-014/120, REQ-XH-020/022)
- **`scripts/ci/test-check-site.sh`** — mutations **(a)–(v)**, each asserting its named leg; publication fixtures (record publishes phase 1; input-set mismatch refused; two records → changelog + superseded `/archive/<v>/`; no-readout and wrong-gate rejected); exit-code + `--head` + real-checkout legs.
- **Profiles** — `build.py --profile internal|public`: absent pages for every §9.2 URL-map path; public renders a phase only where a `hh-site-publication/1` record pins its exact input set (everything else is `not yet published — publication gate pending`, no numbers) and **refuses** fixture labels, preview banners, private dataset hosts, local paths (REQ-XF-142); `robots.txt` + `noindex` trials.
- **`hhsite/publication.py` + `scripts/check-publication.sh`** — record well-formedness, `inputs_digest` recompute, gate-row/readout references, append-only supersede; pin-mismatch is a **refusal**, never a re-pin (REQ-XF-129); manifest-row checks for HUMAN-H12 / GATE-G22 / GATE-G31 / HUMAN-H17 + the operator checklist (REQ-XF-130, REQ-XH-018). Schema + checklist under `docs/results/publication/`. **Zero records — nothing is public until GATE-G22.**
- **`.github/workflows/pages.yml`** — separate deploy lane (ADR-0424): `push:[main]` + `workflow_dispatch` only; `contents:read / pages:write / id-token:write`; SHA-pinned actions (`checkout` v7.0.1, `configure-pages` v6.0.0, `upload-pages-artifact` v5.0.0, `deploy-pages` v5.0.1); `concurrency` group; deploy steps each gated `published == 'yes'` on the record glob — **deploys nothing with zero records** (REQ-XF-128).
- **`scripts/ci/check-pages-workflow.sh` + self-test** — lint for triggers, permissions, 40-hex pins, the record gate before every deploy step, concurrency; 9 mutations.
- **`ci.yml`** — `ci-mode: both` check-site step (work + `--head`) after `id: path`, before the anchor pair; both self-tests added to the existing self-test step; `check-ci-gating.sh` clean.
- **ADR-0424** (AR-28) — the decision record with pinned SHAs; index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BL-47 sources extended.
- **Renderer fixes the legs surfaced**: `<use>` sprite paths broken on depth ≥1 pages; card h3s skipping h1→h3.
